title: GS21 with the priced y factor on production, exposure = standardized PRODUCTIVITY x standardized COUPON (gs_bv 0.1; a product of two firm states, no type)
question: Does a priced second factor make a fair gap in GS21 when the exposure is the PRODUCT of two within-firm states that two different characteristics reveal, so the premium is bilinear in the ranks?
notes:
The second point of the product-exposure ladder; see var-gs_vy-gvyp20-v1 for the construction (exposure gs_bv z~ b~, productivity x coupon, no type). gs_bv 0.1 is the better-behaved magnitude: at low resolution (xnum 41, znum 50, bnum 10, NY 9, 300 firms, 2026-10-11 00:00) a linear fit on ranks of (roe, lev, size, bm) explains 48% of the true premium and pairwise products 90%; the EW market reaches 51% of SR_max; cs-sd of the premium 4.6 %/yr; the mean premium is about zero (+0.3 %/yr); the firm is 2.5x the gs_bv 0 size (vs 7x at 0.2). gs_bv 0.15: 30% / 84% / 34%, mean -1.8 %/yr.

PRECOMMITMENT STATUS: precommitted=false; id read from the Quest solve log by verify_gs_vy_klc.sh before any seed runs. Mechanism probe, not a calibrated GS21.

PREDICTION (2026-10-11, before the run): market share of SR_max 45-60%, room +0.02 to +0.05 with room_s close to room, fair gap +0.003 to +0.012. FALSIFIED if room_s is below +0.015 at the oracle stage or the fair gap is below +0.003.

changes: gs_bv 0.1 x gs_bzb 1.0 z~ b~: productivity x coupon exposure, single type; gs_bzl 0, gs_bzi 0, bv_comp 0
the y factor moves the COST, exp(gs_bc y), with types gs_bc [0.0]; production exposure gs_bv 0, no level compensation (at y = 0 every type pays the same cost)
everything else gvy25's: 9-node priced y chain, gamma_v 2.5, kappa_y 0.35

method.gs_vy_exposure: production x exp(gs_bv gs_bzb z~ b~ y)

seeds.policy: run_oracle.py --seed drives BOTH the firm-level shocks and the aggregate y path (reg_seed offset by the seed).
